## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication) — confirmed by strong Communication/Energy/Industrials 1W performance and simultaneous Tech/Healthcare large-cap weakness (MSFT, ORCL, UNH) as second confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Communication lead: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND; Energy: CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +5.98% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Technology lagging with large-cap pain: MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -11.53% | 1M: -25.38%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare weak: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -3.95%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary softer (TSLA 1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.29%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.11% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Communication).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.31% | 1M: +6.97%) TREND EXHAUSTION, TMO (1W: -7.57% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +9.93%) TREND EXHAUSTION — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Healthcare large caps.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: VZ (1W: +12.65%), TXN (1W: +12.23%), T (1W: +11.11%), META (1W: +8.76%), LMT (1W: +7.35%); note MAJOR divergence across big caps with multiple 1W/1M mismatches (AAPL, CHTR, TMUS, BA) — tactical volatility likely, watch for trend confirmation not core rotation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed to negative in the near term: NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND and GOOGL (1W: +3.07% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND provide pockets of strength, while MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND drag sector 1W: -0.98% (19 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Internally mixed: Financials 1W: +1.39% (20 stocks) with JPM (1W: +2.74% | 1M: -4.99%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and V (1W: -1.33% | 1M: -8.99%) BELOW TREND — sector strength exists but large-cap divergences warrant monitoring.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Weakness dominates but with idiosyncratic winners: JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND backed by bullish FDA news (+80), while UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND is a material downside catalyst; Healthcare 1W: -2.16% (15 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
With NEUTRAL and narrow leadership, favor selective exposure to Energy and Industrials pockets showing ABOVE TREND (CVX (1W: +6.11% | 1M: +16.14%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to Technology names exhibiting clear BELOW TREND signals (MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND); style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND (FDA-driven), VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND (buyback/fiber), TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: UNH (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -7.10% | 1M: -16.33%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Communication (1W: +5.35%, 7 stocks) and Energy (1W: +2.51%, 8 stocks) for continuation.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -0.98%, 19 stocks) and Healthcare (1W: -2.16%, 15 stocks) for downside risk and headline sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +1.91%) ABOVE TREND for hold of recent monthly gains to confirm tech resilience; MSFT (1W: -7.65% | 1M: -11.73%) BELOW TREND — further weekly weakness would confirm broader tech pressure; JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND needs follow-through on approval news to sustain outperformance.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
JNJ (+80): Myeloma approval headline aligns with price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.23% | 1M: +9.83%) — sentiment confirmed.  
VZ (+75): Buyback/fiber story aligns with strong 1W jump ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) — sentiment confirmed.  
LMT (+60): Missile deal and new ventures align with ABOVE TREND strength (1W: +7.35% | 1M: +29.96%) — sentiment confirmed.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
UNH (-60): Earnings shock headline matches sharp price weakness BELOW TREND (1W: -19.46% | 1M: -13.62%) — sentiment confirmed.  
CHTR (-55): Earnings miss headline contrasts with 1W price strength (1W: +7.53% | 1M: -1.66%) — bearish sentiment diverging from short-term buying (distribution risk).  
AMGN (-55): Negative pipeline/headline pressure with downside risk versus mixed price action — monitor for confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership.  
VZ (1W: +12.65% | 1M: +11.28%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +23.68%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +8.76% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: major-cap divergence (AAPL, MSFT, UNH, CHTR) and headline-driven sentiment (UNH bearish, JNJ bullish) require confirmation before expanding exposure.
